title: Layered circuit family
statement: A layered circuit family over the binary alphabet consists of one layered circuit for each input length $n$, with inputs indexed by the $n$ positions and output in the one-point set. Each circuit in the family is finite.
hypotheses_covered: A circuit is specified for every natural number input length
Each circuit is a layered circuit from $n$ binary inputs to a one-point output
Every circuit in the family is finite
caveat: The snippet does not define the structure of a layered circuit or the precise meaning of its finiteness.
